english: For integers $p$ and $q$ with $1\le p\le 20$ and $1\le q\le 20$, let
where $i=\sqrt{-1}$. Let $N$ be the number of ordered pairs $(p,q)$ for which $E_{p,q}$ is an ellipse and $H_{p,q}$ is a hyperbola. Then the value of $N$ is ______.
hindi: पूर्णांकों $p$ तथा $q$ के लिए, जहाँ $1\le p\le 20$ तथा $1\le q\le 20$ हैं, माना कि
जहाँ $i=\sqrt{-1}$ है। माना कि $N$ उन क्रमित युग्मों $(p,q)$ की संख्या है जिनके लिए $E_{p,q}$ एक दीर्घवृत्त है तथा $H_{p,q}$ एक अतिपरवलय है। तब $N$ का मान ______ है।
solution: Both loci have foci $p$ and $qi$, with focal distance $2c=|p-qi|=\sqrt{p^{2}+q^{2}}$
$E_{p,q}$: $2a=20$, $e=\dfrac{\sqrt{p^{2}+q^{2}}}{20}$. Ellipse iff $e<1$; if $p^{2}+q^{2}=400$ it is the segment joining the foci (degenerate), if greater it is empty
$H_{p,q}$: $2a=10$, $e=\dfrac{\sqrt{p^{2}+q^{2}}}{10}$. Hyperbola iff $e>1$; if $p^{2}+q^{2}=100$ it is two rays (degenerate), if smaller it is empty (triangle inequality)
Pairs with $p^{2}+q^{2}\le 100$: for $p=1,\dots,9$ the counts are $9,9,9,9,8,8,7,6,4$, total $69$ (including the boundary pairs $(6,8),(8,6)$)
solution_full: For $E_{p,q}$ and $H_{p,q}$ the fixed points are $z_{1}=p$ and $z_{2}=qi$, and $|z_{1}-z_{2}|=\sqrt{p^{2}+q^{2}}$, which is $2c$ for both loci.

$E_{p,q}$: $|z-z_{1}|+|z-z_{2}|=2a$ with $2a=20$. By the triangle inequality $|z-z_{1}|+|z-z_{2}|\ge|z_{1}-z_{2}|$. If $\sqrt{p^{2}+q^{2}}<20$ the locus is an ellipse with eccentricity $e=\dfrac{\sqrt{p^{2}+q^{2}}}{20}<1$; if $\sqrt{p^{2}+q^{2}}=20$ the locus is the segment $z_{1}z_{2}$ (a degenerate conic, $e=1$), and if $\sqrt{p^{2}+q^{2}}>20$ the locus is empty.

$H_{p,q}$: $\big||z-z_{1}|-|z-z_{2}|\big|=2a$ with $2a=10$. Since $\big||z-z_{1}|-|z-z_{2}|\big|\le|z_{1}-z_{2}|$: if $\sqrt{p^{2}+q^{2}}>10$ the locus is a hyperbola with $e=\dfrac{\sqrt{p^{2}+q^{2}}}{10}>1$; if $\sqrt{p^{2}+q^{2}}=10$ it is the pair of rays on the line $z_{1}z_{2}$ outside the segment (degenerate); if smaller it is empty.
Hence both conditions hold exactly when $100<p^{2}+q^{2}<400$.

Count of pairs with $p^{2}+q^{2}<400$: for each $p$ the number of $q\in\{1,\dots,20\}$ with $q^{2}<400-p^{2}$ is, for $p=1,\dots,19$: $19,19,19,19,19,19,18,18,17,17,16,15,15,14,13,11,10,8,6$ (none for $p=20$). The total is $292$; the pairs $(12,16)$ and $(16,12)$ with $p^{2}+q^{2}=400$ are not included.
Count of pairs with $p^{2}+q^{2}\le100$: for $p=1,\dots,9$: $9,9,9,9,8,8,7,6,4$ (none for $p\ge10$), total $69$. This includes $(6,8)$ and $(8,6)$, for which $H_{p,q}$ is degenerate.
originality_note: New: the same pair of foci carries a focal-sum locus and a focal-difference locus with different constants, so 'ellipse and hyperbola at once' becomes an annulus condition on |p - qi| whose both boundary circles carry degenerate conics, and the answer is a lattice count in that annulus (way 2, a set defined by a construction, then counted). Closest known: identify the locus |z - z1| + |z - z2| = k as ellipse, segment or empty. Different because: two loci are combined, both degenerate cases must be excluded, and a lattice count follows.
key_step: Turn both classifications into 100 < p^2 + q^2 < 400 (excluding both degenerate boundaries) and count lattice points exactly.
justification: Two ideas linked: the triangle-inequality classification of focal-sum and focal-difference loci (with the degenerate equality cases), then an exact lattice count with no options, where a boundary slip changes the answer. Similar counting demand to 2026-P1-Q11 (L3).
stem_review: Read as a student: every curve, point and parameter is introduced, the conditions are complete, there is one reading, the answer is unique and equals the Answer Plan, and the Hindi mirrors the English. Checked that 'ellipse' and 'hyperbola' exclude the segment and the pair of rays, that ordered pairs are counted, and that the ranges of p and q are stated. Answer 223, a positive 3-digit integer. Changed: the word 'and' in the display formula was replaced by a comma so no text sits inside the maths.
blueprint_concepts: Ellipse and hyperbola loci in complex form

concept_use.Classification by eccentricity; degenera: e = |p - qi|/20 < 1 for an ellipse, e = |p - qi|/10 > 1 for a hyperbola; the equality cases give degenerate conics (a segment, a pair of rays) and are excluded.
concept_use.Ellipse and hyperbola loci in complex fo: The loci |z - p| + |z - qi| = 20 and ||z - p| - |z - qi|| = 10 are read as an ellipse and a hyperbola with foci p and qi.
